Ram Mandir Trust Check Bounce Incident Reported

A check for ₹4.10 crore, intended as a donation for the Ram Mandir Trust, has reportedly bounced. The check was issued by a woman from Chennai. According to reports, the account from which the check was drawn had only ₹3 at the time of presentation. The Ram Mandir Trust has remained silent on the matter. The incident has been described as a setback for the trust.
